properties.title: The time step is set by the smallest cells
properties.message: Cell sizes in this grid differ by a factor of 2 or more, and the time step must suit the smallest cells everywhere. A grid with more even cells can run with a longer step: an area-conserving projection, or at high latitudes a polar one.
properties.instruction: Build the grid with mom6_forge's Grid.from_projection, using an equal-area projection, EPSG:3995 in the Arctic or EPSG:3031 in the Antarctic.

references.title: Expert interview 1: Coral Triangle & Benguela Upwelling

evidence.quote: You’ll have to set your time step based on the smallest grid cells in your domain
And if you’re working at higher latitudes, a polar projection would probably make more sense.
